kids.name: note-1
kids.chars: Comfortable values: the Rows readout reads §3 L186's 16.8 px, L0 (the sketch's 17.6 px is compact's). Hide below keeps the sketch's 8.5, and the ladder its 8.5 / 6 px: §6.6 L634 raises that floor at comfortable but states no figure (copy gap). Delta bands show the sketch's 50 / 20 / 5 BTC (§6.2 L524: E18-S06 sets them).

kids.name: note-2
kids.chars: The preview's "Changed: rows." is the sketch's (L455): the spec has no wording for a just-opened dialog (copy gap).
